design.intent: Build a sense of increasing horizontal distance, then let a spring carry the bike across the central canyon.
design.signature: A 36-unit void and long eight-coin spring arc create the widest single reveal so far.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Keep the bike low through three troughs before opening the horizon.
Teach identifying takeoff and landing banks on a small crossing.
Show the distant destination from an early crest with time to settle.
Cross the 36-unit canyon in one deliberate camera sweep with a broad catch.
Return camera and suspension to ground flow after the long flight.
Echo the canyon crossing as a shorter manually controlled flight with an extended catch.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
